Usable assets, measured

The same six briefs and reference images go to five Gateway models. Each model writes Blender geometry. A shared harness exports and reloads the GLB, measures it and renders multiple views. Up to two correction rounds per candidate.

The workflow adapted after high-reasoning requests consumed their token budgets. Later corrections and repeats used low reasoning and streaming. The report retains the original charges and harness corrections. A valid file is only a technical pass. Art quality, functional construction and required movement determine acceptance. Candidates are inspection assets; only reviewed and registered outputs qualify for game integration. Accepted means reusable candidate approval; Prototype marks a valid file below its reference quality target.

Controls

Drag to orbit. Wheel or pinch to zoom. Shift-scroll, Shift-drag or right-drag to pan. Middle-drag orbits. Touch: one finger rotates; two fingers zoom and pan. Fit restores the asset framing.

Accounting

Costs include every generation, failed attempt and model-assisted repair. Unknown billing stays marked unknown. Local build time is reported separately from human cleanup; orchestration subscription costs are not available as per-task charges.

Credit purchases, processing fees and tax are separate from consumed credits. No automatic top-up. $50 cash ceiling.

Small samples establish observed results, not guaranteed future yields. A category with no accepted assets has no established production price.
